# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the sequence: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Each command builds on the last. You cannot stand firm if you are not watchful. You cannot act like men if you have not first stood firm. And you cannot be truly strong without faith as your foundation.

Men, the world tells you strength is optional, that passivity is acceptable, that faith is a private matter. Scripture says otherwise. Your family needs you awake. Your church needs you standing. Your community needs you acting with courage and conviction. But none of that happens by accident. It happens when you choose, daily, to anchor yourself in Christ and refuse to drift.

Strength is not the absence of fear—it is faithfulness in the presence of it. So today, watch. Stand. Act. Be strong. Not in your own power, but in the One who conquered the grave.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, silently repeat: "Stand firm in the faith." Let your body and spirit train together.
